messages:
sophie_support: Customer reported promo code 'SPRING40' is rejected as 'invalid or expired' at checkout despite being shown as active in the dashboard. Customer: user@example.com, account: acct_01G4XH. They attached screenshot of checkout error.

maria_cs: Picking this up. Customer says they used PayPal checkout. Can reproduce on their account in prod sandbox: promo returns 400 and message 'promo_invalid'.

liam_billing: Quick check: SPRING40 was created with payment_method_whitelist = ["card"] per the partner promo rules (sponsored promo only for card payments). If checkout used PayPal we intentionally block stacking. Usually error message is clearer though.

jordan_eng: I pulled logs for acct_01G4XH around 2024-06-24T14:07:33Z. Service responded with our generic promo failure path. Here's trimmed log: 
```
promo_check: id=SPRING40, account=acct_01G4XH, payment_method=paypal, rule=payment_method_whitelist, result=reject
error_code=promo_payment_method_mismatch
message="promo invalid for payment method"
```
Looks like the validator returns a generic client-facing message 'invalid or expired'. We'll repro locally.

sophie_support: So it's by design but UX is wrong. User had no idea PayPal would block it. They thought code was expired. Can we surface clearer message to customer? For now customer asks for manual credit because they expected the discount.

liam_billing: We can grant manual credit for this case. Policy: promo-sponsored discounts can't be applied retroactively to invoices paid via PayPal, but we can give an equivalent one-time credit if approved by billing ops. Requesting manual credit for acct_01G4XH of $40.

billing-bot: Manual credit request created: MC-8943 for acct_01G4XH, amount: $40, requested_by: sophie_support. Status: pending_approval.

jordan_eng: Filed a bug to make the checkout error surface the actual failure reason (promo_payment_method_mismatch) and map it to a helpful message: "This promo requires a credit card payment. If you used PayPal, please switch payment method or contact support." Linking issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2556. Added stack trace and sample request payload.

deploy-bot: INF-2556 created and triaged to eng-runtime backlog, priority P2.

liam_billing: For immediate support: Sophie, after billing approval push through MC-8943 I can apply a one-time invoice credit. Confirm when approved and I'll action.

sophie_support: Thanks — I'll update the customer. For the record, customer said they chose PayPal because they wanted to avoid entering card details. They're okay with a manual credit. I'll reply: 'Sorry about the confusion — SPRING40 is valid but only for card payments; we've requested a manual credit and will update you shortly.' :pray:

maria_cs: Sending that now. Noting to retention: consider adding copy to promo emails/tooltips about card-only restriction.

sophie_support: Closing loop here once MC-8943 completes. Will add an internal note to the account describing reasoning.

maria_cs: Customer responded: 'Thanks for clarifying — please proceed with the credit.' Marking as resolved on ticket until billing updates invoice. :white_check_mark:
